resources.string: Tempo sends anonymous app-health stats — crashes, errors, and which features get used. No account, no identifiers, and never your listening history.
You can change this any time in Settings → Your Data.

This is the complete list of what Tempo sends. Everything is anonymous: no account, no identifiers, and never your listening history.
Nothing is collected until this notice has been shown to you, and you can turn it all off at any time in Settings → Your Data. Builds compiled from source send nothing at all.
